metadata.title: Hunger is killing PVTGs | भूख इन आदिवासियों को लुप्त कर देगी
metadata.description: There were news report from Jharkhand that 19 families of Korwa tribe were not getting ration for last 7 months. It's a particularly vulnerable tribal group and on the verge of extinction due to stagnation in it's population. We try to find out who are the PVTGs and what does it mean for a tribe to be in this category.
